system.description: Action, once per turn: spend MP to sing a verse — a volume (low 10 MP: one creature who can hear you; medium 20: every ally who can hear; high 30: every enemy who can hear) combined with a key (eight, each tied to a damage type, status, Attribute and recovery) and a tone (seven general effects). First level learns all three volumes plus one key and one tone; each further level adds a key or a tone.
